correctness.rationale: Submultiplicativity gives D(T)<=3||T||/4+||T^4||^(1/4)/4. With S^4=0, binomial exact bounds imply ||T^4||^(1/4)<3/20 and hence D(T)<31503/40000<4/5. The normalized sine vector gives numerical radius at least cos(pi/5)+1/10000>4/5. Determinant (1/10000)^4 proves invertibility. Locally uniform series convergence establishes open-set robustness. All steps have exact scope and quantified ranges.

value.rationale: The explicit invertible counterexample refutes a particular published 2012 conjecture in exactly the restricted class for which it was posed, rather than simply rechecking a known nilpotent exception. The open-set proof establishes a robust failure and rules out the proposed nilpotency-only repair.
